Deployment readiness

Ship with confidence. Locally.

ShipCheck is a local-first deployment readiness analyzer. Scan security, build, tests, dependencies, and deployment checks in one terminal command and visualize them in a clean dashboard.

Get started View on GitHub
shipcheck-cli07
$ npx shipcheck-cli07 server
✓ Ready at http://127.0.0.1:3140
$ npx shipcheck-cli07 init
✓ Project registered • Next: shipcheck-cli07 scan
$ npx shipcheck-cli07 scan
SHIP SCORE 92/100
WARN Tests
PASS Security • Build • Dependencies
$
Features

Everything you need to know before you ship

Covers the checks that actually block releases, with clear fixes.

Security first

Secret scanning, .env.example coverage, and console/debugger detection.

Build & Tests

Runs your actual build and test scripts locally with real results.

Dependencies & CI/CD

Audits deps, detects common CI providers, and validates configs.

Post-deploy checks

When you add a deploy URL, run live API probes and Lighthouse performance audits.

Local-first by design

No external APIs. Scans run against your machine, with history stored locally under .data/.

How it works

From repo to readiness in three steps

01

Start

Run shipcheck server to launch the local dashboard.

02

Init

In your project, run shipcheck init to register it.

03

Scan

Run shipcheck scan and review results in the dashboard.

04

Track

History and trends stay local as you iterate.

Preview

See ShipCheck in action

A clean, terminal-inspired dashboard that highlights blockers at a glance.

Install

Get started in seconds

No clone required. Run it directly with npx or install globally.

Quick start (recommended)

$ npx shipcheck-cli07 server

# In another terminal, in your project
$ npx shipcheck-cli07 init
$ npx shipcheck-cli07 scan

Or install globally: npm i -g shipcheck-cli07 && shipcheck-cli07 server
